name: IT Team Performance
description: Metabase dashboard for IT Team Performance

native.query: SELECT assignee_id as assigned_to, COUNT(*) as open_tickets FROM {{TENANT_SCHEMA}}.it_tickets WHERE status = 'OPEN' AND assignee_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY assignee_id ORDER BY open_tickets DESC

SELECT assignee_id as assigned_to, ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (updated_at - created_at))/3600)::numeric, 1) as avg_hours, COUNT(*) as total FROM {{TENANT_SCHEMA}}.it_tickets WHERE status IN ('RESOLVED', 'CLOSED') AND assignee_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY assignee_id ORDER BY avg_hours
